# mlr

## water

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
library(packfor)
library(vegan)

data <- read.csv("E:/wyy/code_project/running_outcome/final_data/SPDB/part0_treat/match/sw_match_treat.csv")
data <- data[, !(colnames(data) %in% c("lon_grid", "lat_grid", "posname"))]

meta_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/dell/OneDrive/file/meta_data.csv")
selected_vars <- meta_data$var_name[meta_data$var_select_w == 1]
selected_vars <- setdiff(selected_vars, "value")
print(colnames(data))

Y <- data['value']  
X <- data[, colnames(data) %in% selected_vars]

result <- forward.sel(Y, X,R2more = 0.001, alpha = 0.05, Xscale=FALSE, Yscale= FALSE)

print(result)

file_path <- "E:/wyy/code_project/running_outcome/final_data/SPDB/part2_analysis/preanalysis/mlr_sw.csv"
write.csv(result, file = file_path, row.names = FALSE)

```

# vpm

## water
```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}

df_raw <- read.csv("E:\\wyy\\code_project\\running_outcome\\final_data\\SPDB\\part0_treat\\match\\sw_match_treat.csv")

meta_data <- read.csv("C:\\Users\\dell\\OneDrive\\file\\meta_data.csv")

vif_data <- read.csv("E:\\wyy\\code_project\\running_outcome\\final_data\\SPDB\\part2_analysis\\preanalysis\\sw_vif_sfs.csv")

list_select <- vif_data$variables
list_select <- c(list_select, 'value')

df_data <- df_raw[, list_select]

library(vegan)

list_1 <- meta_data$var_name[meta_data$var_type3 == 0]
list_2 <- meta_data$var_name[meta_data$var_type3 == 1]
list_3 <- meta_data$var_name[meta_data$var_type3 == 2]


list_col <- colnames(df_data)


X1_cols <- intersect(list_col, list_1)
X1_cols <- X1_cols[X1_cols != "value"] 
X2_cols <- intersect(list_col, list_2)
X3_cols <- intersect(list_col, list_3)


X1 <- as.data.frame(df_data[, X1_cols])
X2 <- as.data.frame(df_data[, X2_cols])
X3 <- as.data.frame(df_data[, X3_cols])



model <- varpart(df_data$value, X1, X2, X3)

summary(model)


path_str <- file.path("E:", "wyy", "code_project", "running_outcome", "final_data", "SPDB", "part2_analysis", "fig")

library(ggplot2)
svg(file.path(path_str, "fig3_sw_vpm0410.svg") , width = 9, height = 6, )
plot(model, Xnames = c("HUM", "ENV", "PFAS"), cutoff = 0.01, cex = 1.8, bg = c("#555c6c", "#4f9c8b", "#d77563"),lwd=3, id.size=1.8, alpha=120)

dev.off()




```



## bio
```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}

df_raw <- read.csv("E:\\wyy\\code_project\\running_outcome\\final_data\\SPDB\\part0_treat\\match\\lr_sw_match_treat_full.csv")
meta_data <- read.csv("C:\\Users\\dell\\OneDrive\\file\\meta_data.csv")

vif_data <- read.csv("E:\\wyy\\code_project\\running_outcome\\final_data\\SPDB\\part2_analysis\\preanalysis\\lr_sw_vif_sfs.csv")

list_select <- vif_data$variables
list_select <- c(list_select, 'value')

df_data <- df_raw[, list_select]

library(vegan)

list_1 <- meta_data$var_name[meta_data$var_type3 == 0]
list_2 <- meta_data$var_name[meta_data$var_type3 == 1]
list_3 <- meta_data$var_name[meta_data$var_type3 == 2]
list_4 <- meta_data$var_name[meta_data$var_type3 == 3]

list_col <- colnames(df_data)

X1_cols <- intersect(list_col, list_1)
X1_cols <- X1_cols[X1_cols != "value"] 
X2_cols <- intersect(list_col, list_2)
X3_cols <- intersect(list_col, list_3)
X4_cols <- intersect(list_col, list_4)


X1 <- as.data.frame(df_data[, X1_cols])
X2 <- as.data.frame(df_data[, X2_cols])
X3 <- as.data.frame(df_data[, X3_cols])
X4 <- as.data.frame(df_data[, X4_cols])


model <- varpart(df_data$value, X1, X2, X3, X4)

summary(model)



path_str <- file.path("E:", "wyy", "code_project", "running_outcome", "final_data", "SPDB", "part2_analysis", "fig")

library(ggplot2)
svg(file.path(path_str, "fig3_lrsw_vpm0410.svg") , width = 9, height = 6, )
plot(model, Xnames = c("HUM", "ENV", "PFAS", "BIO"), cutoff = 0.01, cex = 1.8, bg = c("#555c6c", "#4f9c8b", "#d77563", "#4d8cbf"),lwd=3, id.size=1.8, alpha=125)

dev.off()


```

# sem


## test1-10
```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(lavaan)
library(broom)
df_data <- read.csv("E:\\wyy\\code_project\\running_outcome\\final_data\\SPDB\\part0_treat\\match\\lr_sw_match_treat_full_cluster.csv")

# 创建交互变量
#df_data$TNR_salinity <- df_data$TNR_Ship_CO2_E * df_data$global_salinity
#df_data$GDP_TOTALS_CO2_E <- df_data$GDP * df_data$TOTALS_CO2_E
#df_data$SF6_str <- df_data$SF6 * df_data$str
#df_data$TOTALS_CO2_tcsw <- df_data$TOTALS_CO2_E * df_data$tcsw
#df_data$warp_sp <- df_data$wrap_consumption * df_data$sp

model <- '
    level: 1
        value ~ sw_value + log_Koil_w + po_chain + organ_liver
        sw_value ~ po_m_w + log_Kaw + solubility + log_Koc + log_pKa + po_chain
    level: 2
        value ~ sw_value
        sw_value ~ GDP + tcsw + global_salinity + TOTALS_CO2_E + str + TNR_Ship_CO2_E
        tcsw ~ ctp + ssr + cfc
'

fit <- sem(model, data = df_data,cluster = "cluster", optim.method = "em", em.iter.max=10000)



summary(fit, fit.measures=TRUE)


```
